messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Tipping Example
parts:
I'm trying to reproduce the 'Tipping Example' from
http://had.co.nz/ggplot/examples/tipping.html. However, it returns
errors after the first line of code. What am I doing wrong?

> p <- qplot(total_bill, tip, data = tips)
> setfacets(p, sex ~ .)
Error: could not find function "setfacets"

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Tipping Example
parts:
I think that example is for ggplot, and I assume you're using ggplot2.
You can do qplot(total_bill, tip, facets = sex ~ ., data = tips)
instead.

The ggplot2 page is http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/

Ista
